nouns.name: Person
nouns.sentence: A person is anyone we know: a member, someone who came to a session, someone we wrote to.

properties.name: email
properties.sentence: We write to them here; it can change.

nouns.name: Account
nouns.sentence: An account is what pays us: a company's membership, with the people on it.

properties.name: plan
properties.sentence: The size of membership they pay for.

nouns.name: Company
nouns.sentence: A company is where people work; it may or may not have an account with us.

nouns.name: Session
nouns.sentence: A session is one meeting on one date that people sign up for and come to.

nouns.name: Tag
nouns.sentence: A tag is a word we put on sessions so people can find them.

nouns.name: Topic
nouns.sentence: A topic is what a session is about; topics sit under broader topics.

nouns.name: Profile
nouns.sentence: A profile is the longer story about one person, written by them.

nouns.name: Invite
nouns.sentence: An invite is an email we send to bring someone to a session.

nouns.name: Note
nouns.sentence: A note is what one of us wrote down about a person or an account.
